fields.Name: Company Leader
fields.Description: Leaders of a single company. Sees only that company's lapsed deals, including deals with no expected close date. Emailed even when there is nothing to report.

_comments: Shipped audience types for the Lapsed Close Date Digest. These four rows are vocabulary; their flags drive who sees what. No recipient rows ship, ever: who actually receives a digest is the host's data, not ours.
A host that wants different behaviour should ADD ITS OWN audience row rather than edit these four. A later release that edits a shipped row overwrites whatever the host changed on it.
SubjectTemplate, IntroTemplate and EmptyMessage are NULL on all four on purpose: code supplies neutral defaults, and host-authored copy belongs on rows a host adds.
CTO has SendWhenEmpty = false where Company Leader, CEO and CFO have true. That is deliberate, not a typo.

fields.Name: CEO
fields.Description: Portfolio-wide view of deals lapsed more than 14 days, plus deals with no expected close date, grouped by company. Emailed even when there is nothing to report.

fields.Name: CFO
fields.Description: Portfolio-wide view of every lapsed deal at any age, plus deals with no expected close date, grouped by company. Emailed even when there is nothing to report.

fields.Name: CTO
fields.Description: Portfolio-wide view of deals lapsed more than 14 days, plus deals with no expected close date, grouped by company. Not emailed when there is nothing to report.
